title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of Brent’s 1982 birthday gig with smoking Jerry tones, standout “Far From Me”, “Samson & Delilah” and a memorable Baby Blue encore.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crisp sound‑board source that preserves the high energy of one of the Dead’s classic Boston Garden shows.  Highlights include Brent’s birthday tribute on Far From Me, a ferocious Samson & Delilah, a tight Uncle John’s Band → Playin’ sequence and an emotional Baby Blue encore.  Reviewers rave about Jerry’s guitar fire and the overall party atmosphere despite occasional mix quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating across 19 reviews is ~4.0; comments are overwhelmingly positive about both performance and sound quality, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call the tape crisp and well‑balanced; a few note the SBD is thin or lacks ambient crowd feel, but overall it’s considered listenable and superior to audience tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first set leads into a birthday‑themed second half with strong transitions; the Samson/Delilah climax and heartfelt encore give the show a satisfying arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'smokin'' on strings, delivering a solid reading of Baby Blue and keeping the band’s fire alive.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mix noted as a bit Phil‑lite in places, but his bass still provides steady support.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby’s banter called mouthy and ornery; his high‑octane presence on Samson & Delilah is repeatedly praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent gets birthday shout‑outs, struts on Far From Me and adds piano flair to Uncle John's Band; Mydland receives specific praise for his playing.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drumming highlighted, especially a memorable drum solo and overall percussion excitement.
